notes.nl: Lesmodules: les + code-oefening en/of quiz, per onderdeel zelf instellen wat telt, welke poging, cesuur en weging; eindcijfer met schaal, afronding en voldoende-regel. Cijfers rekenen alles mee.
notes.en: Lesson modules: lesson + code exercise and/or quiz, per part set what counts, which attempt, pass mark and weight; final grade with scale, rounding and pass rule. Grades include everything.
